assertions.text: Output keeps the Report body property to a short note and does not put the 7,000-character text into a text property
Output writes the full text into page content as blocks of at most 2,000 characters using wmgt_split_blocks.py split
Output saves the full text to a scratchpad file, not the repository root
Output states the block count in the preview and plans a read-back that checks each block's opening and closing words in order plus the closing sentence, with no block or paragraph count comparison
Output still requires live approval before the write
Every tool this skill itself plans to call is within its allowed-tools
